hypothesis: Keeping the V3 recipe fixed (60 trading days, raw 128x12 L1-L3 windows, CSZ labels, train_std scaling, 19,800 steps, seeds 11/29/47), a channel-independent PatchTST trunk with two in-network scales (4 coarse 32-bar patches and 16 fine 8-bar patches) may add information to the TLOB/MLPLOB trunks; the fixed-weight blend of all three trunks is expected to improve stable cross-month and risk-neutralized ranking quality without raising turnover.

implementation.input: unchanged 128 x 12 raw L1-L3 order book; shared BiN; CSZ label transform and training entry unchanged
implementation.encoder: channel-independent patch embedding + learnable positional encoding + 3 pre-norm transformer layers per scale
implementation.fusion: per-channel token projection (8 dims), channel concat across both scales, 2-layer scalar head
implementation.tests: tests/test_dual_patch.py: patch geometry/gradients in both branches, invalid contracts, checkpoint roundtrip, end-to-end CSZ runner
implementation.training_entry: jinyi run configs/dual_patch_v3_60d_csz_19800.json (same runner, splits, evaluation)

training.recipe: V3 60d/19800 CSZ raw 12-dim, batch 32, lr 1e-4, train_std, timestamp_zscore_train_rms_matched

decision.standalone: not promoted over V3: validation paired RankIC +0.00060, 5-day block 95% CI [-0.00127, +0.00248] includes zero; however the 3-seed patch trunk leads V3 on raw and neutralized cross-month RankIC in 5/5 replayed months (screen +0.00295/+0.00302, verify +0.00268/+0.00433) with turnover roughly flat
decision.blend: patch-inclusive equal-weight blends are the strongest candidates: blend_all_equal leads V3 on raw and neutralized RankIC in 5/5 months (screen +0.00345/+0.00339, verify +0.00305/+0.00399), turnover about 0.03-0.04 lower, and stress buckets (high volatility/high amount) mostly above V3; the validation-window gain +0.00272 (95% CI +0.00052..+0.00493) meets the pre-registered numeric guardrail, but that window is already used
decision.status: V3 remains the verified submission baseline; the three-trunk equal-weight blend is a verified candidate. No submission package was built in this round.
decision.next: build a fixed-weight three-trunk checkpoint/package, pass the offline flat submission checks, then review promotion with platform validation

evidence_boundary: Local approximate metric convention (gross forward label returns, no fees or execution). The neutralizer is the frozen local approximation of the official BARRA residualization, not the official implementation. The 10-day validation window is the V3 selection window; nov2023/jan2024/mar2024 were used in the initial screen; apr2024/jun2024 were only used for the final re-verification reported here. Stress buckets use trailing 20-day medians and have 5-16 days per month. Block intervals use 5-day moving blocks and 20,000 draws; they measure serial dependence, not day-level independence. Platform submission has not been validated.
